long_description:
Origami is the first AI that automatically gets customers for you. Enter your domain, and let it start working.

Used daily by 10,000+ businesses, Origami gets smarter everyday - learning from your campaigns to find better buyers and drive more revenue for you. On average, customers get 3-6x more positive replies than traditional outbound.

Origami combines Outbound, Lead Generation, Website Visitors Identification, Viral Content & more, starting at $29/month.
